steps.title: An agent chat beside it (the page keeps the focus)
steps.optional: agent backend unavailable on this runner

steps.title: Settle the page (again, after its one reload)
The picker's Debug Settings switch on (older builds gate it)
steps.optional: on by default from this change

steps.title: Design mode on (Ctrl-Opt-Cmd-D, as a person presses it)

params.script: (() => { const el = document.querySelectorAll('p')[0]; if (!el) return false; el.scrollIntoView({block: 'center'}); const r = el.getBoundingClientRect(); const o = {clientX: r.x + Math.min(40, r.width / 2), clientY: r.y + r.height / 2, bubbles: true, button: 0, isPrimary: true, pointerId: 1}; document.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', o)); document.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', o)); return true; })()

steps.title: Comment on the first paragraph

params.comment: Make this text larger and darker

steps.optional: debug.design_mode is new with the comment bubble
